form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Received; read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To extend certain provisions of the Caribbean Basin Economic Recovery Act until September 30, 2030, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Extension of the Caribbean Basin Economic Recovery Act.

section.header: Extension of the Caribbean Basin Economic Recovery Act
section.text: Section 213 of the Caribbean Basin Economic Recovery Act (19 U.S.C. 2703) is amended as follows:

paragraph.header: Extension for certain knit apparel articles

subparagraph.text: in subclause (II)(cc), by striking September 30, 2020 and inserting September 30, 2030; and
in subclause (IV)(dd), by striking September 30, 2020 and inserting September 30, 2030.

paragraph.header: Extension of limitation with respect to certain other apparel articles
paragraph.text: In clause (iv)(II) of such subsection, by striking 18 and inserting 28.
In subsection (b)(5)(D)(i), by striking September 30, 2020 and inserting September 30, 2030.

subsection.text: Section 13031(j)(3) of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985 (19 U.S.C. 58c(j)(3)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (A), by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting October 21, 2029; and
in subparagraph (B)(i), by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting October 21, 2029.

subsection.text: Section 503 of the United States–Korea Free Trade Agreement Implementation Act (Public Law 112–41; 19 U.S.C. 3805 note) is amended by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting October 21, 2029.

section.text: The budgetary effects of this Act, for the purpose of complying with the Statutory Pay-As-You-Go Act of 2010, shall be determined by reference to the latest statement titled Budgetary Effects of PAYGO Legislation for this Act, submitted for printing in the Congressional Record by the Chairman of the House Budget Committee, provided that such statement has been submitted prior to the vote on passage.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 22, 2020.
